title: Vermeil in Gold: The Failing Student and the Strongest Scourge Plunge Into the World of Magic
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Alto, a magic-school student about to repeat a year, accidentally summons Vermeil, a powerful demon sealed in a book, as his familiar. She holds world-ending power and is also openly flirtatious, and the two take on the magic world together. The series ended unfinished after its artist died.
life_message: The publisher frames it as a bond between a struggling student and his familiar, with hints that Vermeil wants to be useful; reviewers mostly see a fanservice comedy.
